summary: @ornikar/storybook-config preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB sibling bundle
details: The package's `preinstall` script `setup.mjs` is heavily obfuscated (hex-suffixed identifiers, string-dictionary indirection typical of javascript-obfuscator output). At install time it probes for a local `bun` binary and otherwise downloads Bun v1.3.13 from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<archive>.zip` into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and uses it to `execFileSync` the adjacent 727KB obfuscated `math_init.js` (a Bun-compiled CJS bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing a shuffled string/integer constant array). The package is advertised as a Storybook configuration helper, a purpose that does not require fetching an alternate language runtime or executing an opaque compiled bundle. The combination of an obfuscated install-lifecycle loader, an alternate-runtime fetch used specifically to run a sibling payload the Node runtime would not execute, and a large opaque compiled blob matches the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
